newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar stays higher by the close.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar stays higher by the close.

text.p: London's August white sugar stayed higher and at the day's peaks by the close on Thursday after a see-saw trade on the back of choppy New York raws market.
The London market recovered ground after New York's October raws broke through the closely-watched 11.00 cents/lb barrier.
The New York contract slid to a low of 10.90 but then rapidly recovered to a high at 11.22 on fund buying.
LIFFE's August ended $1.00 higher at $320.00 per tonne, the session's high, after an intraday low of $316.30 during the slide in New York. October was up $1.30 at $316.50, also the day's best.
Volume reached a hefty 3,096 lots, mainly in August.
